name: rigorium-experimentation
description: Rigorium project-local experimentation: immutable artifacts, explicit grants, idempotent local and authorized SSH/Slurm jobs, analysis, baselines, and recovery. Rigorium 项目内实验：不可变工件、显式授权、幂等的本地与已授权 SSH/Slurm 任务、分析、基线和恢复。

en: Register and inspect immutable SSH connection terms in the current Project.
Preview Project-local stage files with hashes; remote writes occur only during an authorized submit.
Submit, query, recover, or cancel stable SSH and Slurm jobs without rebinding an uncertain job identity.
Analyze completed experiment evidence without launching work or writing files.
zh-CN: 在当前项目中登记和查看不可变的 SSH 连接条款。
仅在本地预检待上传文件及其哈希；远端写入只会发生在已授权的提交过程中。
提交、查询、恢复或取消稳定的 SSH 和 Slurm 任务；不为不确定提交重新绑定任务身份。
仅分析已完成的实验依据，不启动工作，也不写入文件。
